headline: Police Detain Protesters at Azad Maidan
summary: Goa police detained several demonstrators and blocked entry to Azad Maidan during a protest against CEC Gyanesh Kumar. The heavy police deployment led to high drama and multiple arrests.

headline: Police Block CJP Protest Against CEC
summary: Dozens of demonstrators participating in a CJP protest against Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar were blocked and detained by authorities in Goa. The action drew widespread attention and swift political reactions.

headline: High Court Orders Release of 7 Protesters
summary: The High Court ordered the release of seven protesters in Goa, noting that their detention may not have been authorized. The special sitting came in the wake of widespread arrests during anti-EC demonstrations.

headline: Two Booked for Cheating in IIT-Goa Exam
summary: Following a similar incident at IIT-Bombay, two individuals were booked for cheating in the IIT-Goa recruitment exam. Authorities recovered Bluetooth earpieces and SIM cards used in the malpractice.

headline: Two Held at Goa Airport Over Exam Cheating
summary: Two candidates were arrested at the Goa airport for attempting to cheat in the IIT-Goa recruitment exam. CISF personnel intercepted the suspects after finding prohibited communication gadgets in their possession.

headline: CISF Catches IIT Job Exam Cheaters at Airport
summary: Police formally booked two individuals for cheating in the IIT Goa recruitment exam after CISF personnel caught them at the airport. The suspects were carrying Bluetooth devices to relay answers.

headline: Revanth Reddy Accuses BJP of Drug Trade
summary: Telangana Chief Minister Revanth Reddy alleged that the BJP has turned Goa into a hub for drug peddlers. The remarks were made during the Congress party's ongoing yatra in the state.

headline: Telangana CM Joins Congress Goa Yatra
summary: Telangana Chief Minister Revanth Reddy arrived in Goa to participate in the Congress party's political yatra. He used the platform to campaign against the ruling administration.

headline: Revanth Reddy Likens BJP to 'Ravan'
summary: Comparing the BJP to 'Ravan' and the Congress to 'Ram', Telangana CM Revanth Reddy urged Goa voters to defeat the ruling party. He made the comments during a public address on the campaign trail.

headline: Goa Resident Arrested in Drug Supply Case
summary: A local man was arrested in Goa in connection with an ongoing drug supply investigation. Law enforcement officials apprehended the suspect as part of a broader crackdown on narcotics.

headline: Interstate Drug Supplier Arrested in Goa
summary: Authorities successfully apprehended an interstate drug supplier operating within Goa. The arrest highlights ongoing collaborative efforts between local and specialized enforcement units to curb drug trafficking.

headline: EAGLE Force Apprehends Drug Supplier
summary: The EAGLE Force, with assistance from the Goa Police, apprehended a suspected drug supplier in the state. The joint operation resulted in the seizure of illicit substances and further arrests.

headline: Autopsy Confirms Nana Patekar Died of Heart Attack
summary: An autopsy confirmed that Nana Patekar passed away due to a heart attack in Goa, with authorities finding no evidence of foul play. The medical report cleared up the immediate cause of his sudden death.

headline: Autopsy Points to Blood Clot in Heart Artery
summary: Post-mortem results revealed that a blood clot in a major heart artery caused the sudden death of Nana Patekar in Goa. Hospital authorities and police confirmed the medical findings following examination.

headline: Police Register Unnatural Death in Patekar Case
summary: Goa police officially registered an unnatural death case following the demise of Nana Patekar. Standard protocol was followed with a post-mortem conducted at the Goa Medical College.

headline: New Book Documents Goa Priest's Legacy
summary: A newly published book highlights the ecological legacy and environmental contributions of a prominent Goa priest. The work showcases his lifelong dedication to nature conservation in the region.

headline: Arjun Tendulkar Excluded from Goa Ranji Squad
summary: All-rounder Arjun Tendulkar's name was notably missing as Goa announced its squad for the upcoming Ranji Trophy matches. The selection omission drew significant attention from cricket followers.

headline: Questions Raised Over Congress Yatra Impact
summary: Local political analysts weighed in on the recent Congress yatra in Goa, debating its actual electoral impact. Critics and commentators offered mixed reviews of the high-profile campaign events.

headline: Details Emerge of Nana Patekar's Final Hours
summary: Reports detailed the final hours of Nana Patekar in Goa, including a caretaker's emergency call and attempts at administering CPR. Medical professionals tried to revive him for nearly 45 minutes before he was pronounced dead.

headline: Revanth Reddy Blames Top Leaders for Drug Hub
summary: Telangana CM Revanth Reddy accused Prime Minister Narendra Modi and Amit Shah of turning Goa into a haven for drug trafficking. The sharp criticism came during his political engagements in the state.

headline: Two Booked for IIT Exam Malpractice
summary: Two candidates were officially booked for using electronic gadgets to cheat during the IIT Goa recruitment exam. Authorities seized Bluetooth devices used in the coordinated cheating attempt.

headline: Police Explain Unnatural Death Registration
summary: Goa Police clarified why Nana Patekar's sudden death was formally registered as an 'unnatural death' under standard procedure. Family members, including his son and hospital authorities, cooperated with the inquiry.

headline: Unnatural Death Case Filed in Patekar Passing
summary: Goa police registered an unnatural death case regarding the passing of Nana Patekar, ensuring a thorough procedural review. The post-mortem examination was successfully completed at GMC.

headline: Post-Mortem Completed in Patekar Death Case
summary: The post-mortem examination for Nana Patekar was conducted at the Goa Medical College as police filed an unnatural death report. Authorities assured the public that the investigation follows standard protocols.

headline: Mining Resumption Set to Be 2027 Poll Issue
summary: Political analysts predict that the resumption of iron ore mining will emerge as a major electoral plank in Goa's upcoming 2027 assembly elections. Parties are already positioning themselves on the contentious economic issue.

headline: Poinguinim Sarpanch Criticized for Skipping Sabha
summary: The sarpanch of Poinguinim drew severe criticism from locals after failing to attend the scheduled gram sabha. Residents expressed frustration over the lack of leadership during the community meeting.

headline: CISF Intercepts Job Exam Cheaters in Goa
summary: CISF security personnel at the Goa airport successfully intercepted two passengers carrying sophisticated cheating gadgets meant for an IIT recruitment exam. The suspects were promptly handed over to the police.

headline: Activist Completes 7,000km Sustainability Trek
summary: An environmental advocate traveled 7,000 kilometers carrying a backpack and 9,000 seed packets to champion sustainability. The journey concluded with widespread praise for grassroots ecological efforts.

headline: IPSCDL Seeks to Hand Over Smart Projects
summary: The Imagine Panaji Smart City Development Limited has initiated moves to transfer completed projects to the Corporation of the City of Panaji. However, the local council expressed financial concerns regarding long-term maintenance funds.

headline: Tourism Department Issues Stray Dog Relocation Warning
summary: Goa's tourism department has given a seven-day window for animal welfare advocates and locals to adopt beach stray dogs before relocation begins. The initiative aims to clear certain tourist zones.

headline: Bicholim Initiates Plan to Revive Fallow Lands
summary: Local authorities in Bicholim have launched a comprehensive plan to cultivate and revive fallow agricultural lands. The initiative aims to boost local food production and enhance green cover.

headline: Apparel Cluster Approved in Honda, Creating Jobs
summary: The Goa government has cleared a new apparel manufacturing cluster in Honda, projected to generate around 300 local jobs. The industrial project aims to boost manufacturing in the taluka.

headline: Khaunte Emphasizes Creative Industry for Tourism
summary: Tourism Minister Rohan Khaunte stated that focusing on the creative industry can significantly boost Goa's tech ecosystem and encourage long-stay tourism. He highlighted the need to diversify beyond conventional holidaymakers.

headline: DRDO Scientist to Discuss Surveillance Technologies
summary: A prominent DRDO scientist is scheduled to deliver a public talk on India's advancements in maritime and aerial surveillance. The session will highlight domestic defense technological capabilities.

headline: Bicholim Locals Demand CCTV to Stop Pollution
summary: Residents of Bicholim have petitioned local authorities to install CCTV cameras along water bodies to curb illegal river pollution. Community members hope surveillance will deter dumping of waste.

headline: Goa Tourism Hopes for Q4 Revival Amid Flat Footfall
summary: Tourist footfall in Goa remained largely flat through the year, prompting the hospitality sector to pin its hopes on a stronger turnaround between October and December. Industry stakeholders are banking on the peak festive season.

headline: Smart City Entity Transitions to State SPV
summary: Acting on directives from the central government, Goa has transitioned its smart city framework into a state-level Special Purpose Vehicle. The administrative shift aims to streamline project execution.

headline: Govt Shifts Mirabag Water Project to Panchawadi
summary: The Goa government has officially relocated the Rs 228 crore Mirabag water infrastructure project to Panchawadi. Chief Minister Pramod Sawant confirmed the administrative decision regarding the revised site.

headline: GFP's Tilt Toward Congress Sparks Alliance Talk
summary: The Goa Forward Party's growing alignment with the Congress opposition bloc has revived discussions of a grand opposition 'mahagathbandhan'. Political observers believe this could reshape upcoming electoral equations.

headline: WRD Desilts Savlem Lake in Pilerne
summary: The Water Resources Department has completed desilting work at the Savlem lake located in Pilerne. The initiative is expected to improve water retention and prevent localized flooding during heavy rains.

headline: Opa Barrage Gates Shut Amid Dipping Water Levels
summary: Authorities have shut the gates of the Opa barrage following a noticeable drop in local water levels. The precautionary measure is designed to conserve available water reserves for distribution.

headline: Goa and Mizoram Exchange Youth Delegations
summary: Goa and Mizoram organized a cultural youth delegation exchange program to foster national integration. Participants shared traditional arts, music, and cultural insights during the visit.

headline: High Court Orders Release of Anti-EC Protesters
summary: In a special sitting, the Bombay High Court in Goa ordered the immediate release of several protesters detained during demonstrations against election officials. The court reviewed the legality of the police actions.

headline: Rahul Gandhi's Goa Yatra Visit Called Off
summary: Rahul Gandhi's planned visit to Goa for the Goy Rakhonn Yatra has been officially called off. Local organizers confirmed the cancellation of the senior leader's itinerary.

headline: Goa Extends KPMG Contract for Tourism Master Plan
summary: The Goa government has extended its consultancy contract with KPMG for the state's tourism master plan at a rate of Rs 8 lakh per month. The continuation aims to guide long-term tourism policy.

headline: Goa Cabinet Approves Key Tourism and Urban Decisions
summary: The Goa cabinet cleared a slew of policy decisions spanning the tourism, agriculture, and urban development sectors. Officials stated the measures are designed to enhance infrastructure and administrative efficiency.

headline: Police Thwart CJP Protest at Azad Maidan
summary: High drama unfolded at Azad Maidan as police forces successfully thwarted a protest organized by the CJP. Activists attempting to gather were quickly contained and dispersed by law enforcement.

headline: Mirabag Barrage Project Relocated to Panchawadi
summary: Chief Minister Pramod Sawant announced that the Mirabag barrage project has been officially shifted to Panchawadi. The infrastructure initiative is part of the state's ongoing water resource development.

headline: HC Quashes Municipal Delimitation Notification
summary: The High Court quashed Goa's municipal delimitation notification, citing a lack of 'meaningful consultation' with stakeholders. The ruling necessitates a fresh review of municipal boundaries.

headline: NGT Extends Stay on Mormugao Port Channel Project
summary: The National Green Tribunal has extended its stay on the Mormugao port's channel deepening project. Environmental concerns raised by local communities prompted the continued judicial pause.
